lead: A `Core` member that answers a walk returns a registered memberless class, never `crate::cursor`'s unregistered one.
body: `every_instance_type_names_a_registered_class` requires a `CoreTy::Instance` return type to name a `CLASSES` row and `CoreTy::Iterated` is parameter position only, so a second internal class on `instance::INTERNAL_CLASSES` cannot compile. Copy `Core\IO\Lines`: a memberless `CLASSES` row, an `ITERABLES` row for the element type, a `HANDLES` entry, and `iterate`/`advance`/`current` on `instance`'s dispatch roster; `crate::cursor` is only for a snapshot already held.
